By integrating the domain-specific aspect preference and the domain-agnostic aspect preference, MSDCR attains a thorough understanding of user preferences across each data-poor domain. The empirical evaluations on real-world datasets unequivocally demonstrate the superiority of MSDCR against state-of-the-art single-domain and CDR models.

When access to the original data isn't possible, the model is trained using only hard, high-confidence instances that can be obtained from the network's output, without needing access to its internal workings. This proposed optimization method is applied to both LSTM and GRU models and demonstrates significant model size reductions and improved accuracy in comparison to the conventional learning method.
